raw_segments.text: Apollo, yea, for it stands not with a common death that he should die, a chieftain and
a king decked with the scepter which high heaven confers die, and by female hands, not
smitten down by a far-shooting bow, held stalwartly by some strong Amazon.
Another doom was his, O palace here and ye who sit in judgment to discern this thing
She with a specious voice of welcome true hailed him, returning from the mighty mart
where war for life gives fame, triumphant home.
Then o'er the laver as he bathed himself, she spread from head to foot a covering net,
and in the endless mesh of cunning robes and wound and trapped her lord and smote him down.
Lo, ye have heard what doom this chieftain met, the majesty of Greece, the fleet's high
Such as I tell it, let it gall your ears, who stand as judges to decide this cause.
